<!-- Search existing issues and read SPEC.md / CONTRIBUTING.md first. -->

## User problem

Who needs this, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe a concrete example of the desired outcome.

## Alternatives

What existing behavior or smaller change could address the problem?

## Scope and compatibility

Identify affected UI, REST/MCP operations, data, dependencies, provider costs,
or configuration. Note whether this belongs to baseline v1 or future work.

## Acceptance criteria

How would a reviewer verify that this is complete?
